product.name: Dell 7FMXV Battery
product.full_name: Replacement Battery for Dell Latitude 5400 / 5500 / Precision 3540 / 3550 Series
product.description: Replacement battery (Type 7FMXV) for Dell Latitude 5400, 5401, 5410, 5411, 5500, 5510, 5511 and Dell Precision 3540, 3550 series laptops. Also cross-compatible with Dell part numbers 0WMRC, GJKNX, CYMGM, JGXYM, 1VX1H and 4GVGH depending on revision. 63Wh, 15.2V Li-Ion. Tested before dispatch, drop-in fit — no disassembly beyond the standard battery bay.

delivery_note: Same-day delivery in Nairobi · 1–2 days upcountry

faqs.question: Do you offer warranty on this battery?
faqs.answer: Yes — this battery carries a 6-month warranty from the date of purchase.

faqs.question: How do I install it?
faqs.answer: It's a standard drop-in replacement — no disassembly beyond the battery bay. We can talk you through it on WhatsApp if needed.

faqs.question: Can I pay via M-Pesa?
faqs.answer: Yes, M-Pesa is accepted, along with cash on delivery in select areas.
